name: bookings
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bookings (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"customerName" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	service VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	note VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"preferredDate" DATE NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: brands
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_brands_name ON brands (name)

name: inventories
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventories (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sku VARCHAR(100), 
	barcode VARCHAR(100), 
	manufacturer VARCHAR(200) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	fitments JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	"highVoltage" BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"unitPrice" NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	"updatedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (sku), 
	UNIQUE (barcode)
)

name: login_attempts
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS login_attempts (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	identifier VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	success BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	attempted_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: system_parameters
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_parameters (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	value VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_system_parameters_key ON system_parameters (key)

name: users
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	password VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"fullName" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"isActive" BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	"sessionVersion" INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	"disabledPermissions" JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	"lastLoginAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	"updatedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_email ON users (email)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_username ON users (username)

name: wages
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wages (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	price NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_wages_name ON wages (name)

name: employee_profiles
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employee_profiles (
	"userId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	department VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	"jobTitle" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	"startDate" DATE NOT NULL, 
	note VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	"updatedBy" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"updatedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY ("userId"), 
	FOREIGN KEY("userId") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("updatedBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: expenses
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expenses (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payee VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	"documentNumber" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL, 
	note VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	"createdBy" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"approvedBy" INTEGER, 
	"approvedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"paidBy" INTEGER, 
	"paidAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	method VARCHAR(20), 
	reference VARCHAR(100), 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT expense_positive CHECK (amount > 0), 
	UNIQUE ("documentNumber"), 
	FOREIGN KEY("createdBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("approvedBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("paidBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: inventory_movements
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory_movements (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"inventoryId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"quantityChange" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"balanceAfter" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY("inventoryId") REFERENCES inventories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: leave_requests
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leave_requests (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"userId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"fromDate" DATE NOT NULL, 
	"toDate" DATE NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	"decidedBy" INTEGER, 
	"decisionNote" VARCHAR(2000), 
	"decidedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY("userId") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("decidedBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: maintenance_profiles
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maintenance_profiles (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	scope JSON NOT NULL, 
	rules JSON NOT NULL, 
	"sourceUrl" VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	"sourcePage" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	version VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	"approvedBy" INTEGER, 
	"approvedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY("approvedBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: mechanics
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mechanics (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"userId" INTEGER, 
	"fullName" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR, 
	specialty VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	"updatedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE ("userId"), 
	FOREIGN KEY("userId") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: staff_certificates
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS staff_certificates (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"userId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	issuer VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	"certificateNumber" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	"validFrom" DATE NOT NULL, 
	"validUntil" DATE NOT NULL, 
	"verifiedBy" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'verified' NOT NULL, 
	"revokedBy" INTEGER, 
	"revokedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"revokeReason" VARCHAR(2000), 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_staff_certificate UNIQUE ("userId", issuer, "certificateNumber"), 
	FOREIGN KEY("userId") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("verifiedBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("revokedBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: staff_shifts
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS staff_shifts (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"userId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"startsAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	"endsAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	bay VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	note VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	"createdBy" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT shift_order CHECK ("endsAt" > "startsAt"), 
	FOREIGN KEY("userId") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("createdBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: vehicles
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicles (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"customerId" INTEGER, 
	"licensePlate" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"customerName" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	address VARCHAR, 
	"carBrand" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"carModel" VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"receivedDate" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	"updatedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY("customerId") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: maintenance_reminders
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maintenance_reminders (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"vehicleId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"profileId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"ruleKey" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	"cycleKey" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	summary JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	"publishedBy" INTEGER, 
	"publishedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_maintenance_cycle UNIQUE ("vehicleId", "profileId", "ruleKey", "cycleKey"), 
	FOREIGN KEY("vehicleId") REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("profileId") REFERENCES maintenance_profiles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("publishedBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: service_visits
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service_visits (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"vehicleId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"advisorId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"mechanicId" INTEGER, 
	concern VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	"initialInspection" VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	diagnosis VARCHAR(4000), 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	qc JSON, 
	"qcBy" INTEGER, 
	"qcAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY("vehicleId") REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("advisorId") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("mechanicId") REFERENCES mechanics (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("qcBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: vehicle_care
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicle_care (
	"vehicleId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"profileId" INTEGER, 
	vin VARCHAR(17), 
	"modelYear" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	engine VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	gearbox VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	market VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	usage VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	"firstUseDate" DATE NOT NULL, 
	odometer INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"observedOn" DATE NOT NULL, 
	"updatedBy" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("vehicleId"), 
	CONSTRAINT care_odometer_nonnegative CHECK (odometer >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY("vehicleId") REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("profileId") REFERENCES maintenance_profiles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE (vin), 
	FOREIGN KEY("updatedBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: repair_tickets
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS repair_tickets (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"mechanicId" INTEGER, 
	"serviceVisitId" INTEGER, 
	"vehicleId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"totalAmount" NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL, 
	"mechanicName" VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"startedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"completedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"paidAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	"updatedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY("mechanicId") REFERENCES mechanics (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE ("serviceVisitId"), 
	FOREIGN KEY("serviceVisitId") REFERENCES service_visits (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("vehicleId") REFERENCES vehicles (id)
)

name: service_followups
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service_followups (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"visitId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	rating INTEGER, 
	note VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	"nextContactOn" DATE, 
	"createdBy" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY("visitId") REFERENCES service_visits (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("createdBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: service_quotes
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service_quotes (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"visitId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	stage VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	items JSON NOT NULL, 
	"totalAmount" NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	"decidedBy" INTEGER, 
	"decisionNote" VARCHAR(2000), 
	"decidedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_visit_revision UNIQUE ("visitId", revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY("visitId") REFERENCES service_visits (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("decidedBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: maintenance_records
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maintenance_records (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"vehicleId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	component VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	"performedOn" DATE NOT NULL, 
	odometer INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"ticketId" INTEGER, 
	note VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	"createdBy" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_maintenance_record UNIQUE ("vehicleId", component, action, "performedOn", odometer), 
	FOREIGN KEY("vehicleId") REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("ticketId") REFERENCES repair_tickets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("createdBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: payment_receipts
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payment_receipts (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"ticketId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	"receivedBy" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE ("ticketId"), 
	FOREIGN KEY("ticketId") REFERENCES repair_tickets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("receivedBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: repair_items
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS repair_items (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"inventoryId" INTEGER, 
	"repairTicketId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"taskName" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"partName" VARCHAR, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"partPrice" NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL, 
	"laborPrice" NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL, 
	"totalPrice" NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL, 
	"isCompleted" BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	"evidenceRound" INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	"partCode" VARCHAR(100), 
	"completedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	"updatedAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY("inventoryId") REFERENCES inventories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("repairTicketId") REFERENCES repair_tickets (id)
)

name: repair_evidence
table:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS repair_evidence (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"itemId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	round INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	"productCode" VARCHAR(100), 
	"expectedCode" VARCHAR(100), 
	"lotNumber" VARCHAR(100), 
	note VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	image BYTEA NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	"createdBy" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"createdAt" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY("itemId") REFERENCES repair_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY("createdBy") REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
